verdict.rationale: Google Cloud is a cloud platform, so a webhook-subscription story applies. The pack contains no documented, registrable outbound HTTP callbacks. Budget notifications go to Pub/Sub topics (no push-to-HTTP endpoint is described), and the API hub sync relies on a customer-deployed Lambda or Azure Function to relay events inbound. Both are adjacent mechanisms or user-side workarounds, not webhooks.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
